messages:
Lena Park: short thread 30 - we need to pick the minimal observability surface for the next release. customers pushing: BrightLayer (per-route visibility), Vaulted (alerting on error spikes), and a few SMEs asking for sampling controls. laying out a small plan below.
Tom Rivera: thanks. can we be explicit about what is GA vs experimental? finance will want clarity if billing is affected.
Priya Shah: proposed minimum set: (A) cost view: per-model now, per-route later (exp), (B) trace-link hook: clickthrough to trace explorer + sampling knob (experimental), (C) error insights: grouped stacks + quick filters (experimental->beta).
Nadia Gomez: infra constraints: route-level costing requires adding route_id to token telemetry and a nightly aggregation job. low perf risk but DB index change needed. estimate: 2 backend sprints for safe rollout if we do route-level from day one.
Tom Rivera: if we aim to ship faster, do per-model first and mark route-level as "coming soon". but include a migration telemetry flag so we don't reprocess historical data later.
Priya Shah: agree on incremental approach. UI will show a toggle: "View: per-model | per-route (beta)" and when mapping missing show a banner linking to docs.
Lena Park: acceptance criteria suggestions: cost view GA = documented delta <5% vs ground-truth jobs, visible in console, and finance sign-off on wording. trace-link experiment = working clickthrough + sampling control with adaptive default. error insights = groups visible, ability to open raw traces, and one templated alert.
infra-bot: Note: adding route_id to telemetry requires schema patch v2.1 and a migration plan.
Nadia Gomez: rollout plan idea: week A dogfood (internal teams, 5% traffic), week B invited pilots (20%), week C open beta (100% but feature flag), GA after finance + SRE sign-off.
Tom Rivera: communications: draft changelog + customer email for pilot customers. include explicit note that billing won't change until GA and we'll provide a reconciliation report.
Priya Shah: quick frontend note - mockups for per-model table with sparkline + cost column ready by Tue. column names: route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, estimated_cost_usd. small json example: `{"columns":["route","model","tokens","cost","95p_lat"]}`
Lena Park: CLI ops for sampling control: `rw obs sampling set --target route:R1 --rate 0.005` (defaults to adaptive). include API parity for private deployments.
Tom Rivera: risk list: 1) finance disputes if interim per-model numbers differ significantly, 2) SLO regressions if sampling misconfigured, 3) support queue spike when we flip from per-model->per-route.
Nadia Gomez: mitigations: (i) include a reconciliation endpoint for billing teams, (ii) sampling default to adaptive and capped, (iii) docs + quick FAQs for support.
Priya Shah: success metrics to gate GA: pilot adoption (>=3 customers using the view), variance <5% for canonical workloads, no increase in 95p latency.
Lena Park: action items: 1) Tom: draft finance blurb and pilot invite by EOD Wed. 2) Nadia: telemetry design doc (route mapping + aggregation) by next Monday. 3) Priya: initial mocks + banner states by Tue. 4) Eng: prepare canary rollback plan. react with :white_check_mark: when done.
deploy-bot: CI green for branch feature/obs-mini-launch - e2e 10/10.
Tom Rivera: I'll start the finance thread now. thanks all, quick sync tomorrow 9:30 to finalize cut decisions.
